thread.title: Video: Worldpay CEO on Why Blockchain Is an 'Opportunity'

author: thestreet.com
title: Video: Worldpay CEO on Why Blockchain Is an 'Opportunity'
text:
Philip Jansen, co-CEO of Worldpay ( WP ) , views blockchain technology as an opportunity, rather than a threat.
His companies deals with over 300 payment types and blockchain technology may soon be added to the list.
Vantiv closed on its 2017 merger with Worldpay on Tuesday. Worldpay's clients include Apple ( AAPL ) and Alphabet's ( GOOGL ) Google.
